name: vm
algorithm: Run a 23-opcode register-based bytecode virtual machine (flat register file, call-frame stack, bounds-checked array heap, switch dispatch) over four deterministic bytecode programs (recursive fibonacci, iterative prime sieve, loop arithmetic/checksum, and Shell sort plus weighted dot product) parameterized by CLI arguments (README.md).
notes: The bytecode VM and its four programs are the task itself (README.md), so every cell is kind std with zero external dependencies.
Standard switch/match dispatch everywhere: no computed goto, no unsafe, no unchecked indexing, no inlining or branch hints.
Overflow class never: all arithmetic uses signed 64-bit integers and stays well within i64 bounds.
The publish arguments are provisional until verify -publish-size confirms the 1 s floor on a quiet machine.
